verdict.rationale: Scribe documents a `channel_separation` option that transcribes the left and right channels of a stereo input independently and tags each segment with a channel number. The synchronous API schema lists channel-separation controls and returns channel labels, so each side of a call stays separate. Missing for 10: evidence for more than two channels, confirmation that channel separation works in batch and live modes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, stereo or multichannel recordings can be transcribed per channel, so each side of a call stays separate

citations.quote: channel_separation processes the left and right channels of a stereo input independently and adds a channel number to each segment.
Its JSON response includes transcript segments, speaker or channel labels, and timing fields.
